name: I'm Not the Hero
source:
Khiri is definitely not a hero. In fact, he prefers it that way. Being friends with a hero is enough work. But when the real hero's brother is supposedly taken by the vampire clan, Khiri is the only one who can save him–-by seducing the head vampire, Bel.

[From [url=https://lin-augustine.itch.io/im-not-the-hero]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
希里绝对不是英雄。事实上，他更喜欢这样。与英雄成为朋友就足够了。但当真正英雄的兄弟据说被吸血鬼部落带走时，希里是唯一能拯救他的人——通过引诱吸血鬼头目贝尔。

[来自[url=https://lin-augustine.itch.io/im-not-the-hero]Itch.io[/url]]
